name: Depth-aware Order-independent Rendering
definition: A rendering scheme that eliminates the need for Gaussian depth sorting by using a depth-aware weighting strategy to order-independently blend all related 3D Gaussians to a pixel, addressing the computational bottleneck of sorting in traditional alpha blending.
summary: Depth-aware Order-independent Rendering uses neural networks to predict view-dependent weights for parallel Gaussian blending, eliminating depth sorting and improving visual quality over fixed-weight methods.
